:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noExcessiveNestedBlocks`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`max-nesting-depth`](https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/blob/main/lib/rules/max-nesting-depth/README.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveNestedBlocks": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Enforce a maximum depth that blocks can be nested.

Deeply nested styles are difficult to read and follow. Every level of nesting also makes
the resulting selector longer, which makes the styles harder to override. This rule reports
`{}` blocks nested beyond the configured limit.

The block of a rule or at-rule written at the top level of the file isn't nested, so it
doesn't count as a level. Wrapping styles in a top-level at-rule, such as `@media` or
`@layer`, doesn't add a level either. Every other block adds one level.

Only the outermost block exceeding the limit is reported: blocks nested inside it aren't
reported again.

## Examples

### Invalid

```css
.a {
    .b {
        .c {
            .d {
                .e {
                    .f {
                        color: red;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Valid

```css
.a {
    .b {
        .c {
            .d {
                .e {
                    color: red;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@media (width >= 600px) {
    .a {
        .b {
            .c {
                .d {
                    .e {
                        color: red;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Options

### max

Default: 4

The maximum block nesting depth allowed.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveNestedBlocks": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"max": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```css
.a {
    .b {
        .c {
            color: red;
        }
    }
}
```

Visit </span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"><a href=\"https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery\">https://biomejs.dev/linter/#nursery</a></span><span style=\"color: lightgreen;\"> for more information.</span><br />  <br /></code></pre>"} />

#### Valid

```css
.a {
    .b {
        color: red;
    }
}
```

### ignoreAtRules

Default: `[]`

A list of at-rule names, without the leading `@`. The blocks of these at-rules don't count
as a level and are never reported. Names are matched regardless of letter case.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noExcessiveNestedBlocks": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"max": 1,
						"ignoreAtRules": [
							"media"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```css
.a {
    @media print {
        .b {
            color: red;
        }
    }
}
```
